How do I use it properly the very first time?
menu
Using your Eternity® arrangement for the first time is effortless!
When your box arrives, simply place it in a room-temperature area away from direct sunlight. Keep the flowers inside their box or vase—they are secured there and meant to stay inside.
Do not water them or place anything on top of the blooms. If dust gathers over time, lightly remove it using a duster.
